title: Viva Engage: richer shared message previews and a full conversation dialog
notes: claim 47: severity major on a rationale: risk rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: The briefing passes: its rollout facts, licensing background and gaps in feature-specific controls are supported. The risk rationale should drop its assurance that the change introduces no new data source, which Microsoft's notice does not establish.
